description: This Java source file defines the exception class 'LoanChargeNotFoundException' used within the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.charge.exception' package. It extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' and provides multiple constructors to handle various scenarios where a loan charge is not found, such as by ID, loan ID, external ID, and handling exceptions. The class is part of the error handling mechanisms for missing or invalid loan charge references in the Fineract project.

classes.description: Exception thrown when a loan charge cannot be found, either by ID, external ID, or associated loan ID.
